name: example_scene_kit
prompt: a roadside gas station at dusk, wet asphalt, the canopy lights on, mountains behind
_help: One job -> the game's six-file scene set at the top of out/<id>/: scene.png, scene_n.png (normals from depth), scene_e.png (glow), scene_back.png (far plane, wider by the overscan), scene_over.png (walk-behind plane), scene_depth.png (16-bit, white = near), plus layers.json and contact.png. Add "init" (a greybox) + "denoise" + "control": {"type": "canny"} to repaint a layout instead. Approve with: approve.bat <job-id> scenes/<map> --set
